scope: Uniform Qwen122 expressed-mechanism labelling of all saved probability-first explanations for original fixed50 control-to-1NN test flips across all12 judges, five backbones, ten datasets.
selection: Only saved flip records; no fresh source judge calls or retries. Eligible text includes capped/invalid-format prose; assessability explicitly labelled. Missing/errors/ambiguous outcomes retained outside inference.
blinding: Only explanation text sent to labeler. No target gold, original scores, pair mechanism labels, correctness, judge identity, or target/neighbour text; latter omitted deliberately to prevent inferring mechanisms absent from explanation.
meaning: Expressed evidence only, not private reasoning or causal use. Original pair labels joined privately after annotation.
resume: Never retry attempted units with no durable raw output. Commit invalid outputs explicitly. Source raw and all new raw preserved.
analysis: Compare original independent pair labels with expressed labels; by judge/dataset/outcome, plus retained-answer subset; cluster repeated targets. Report unassessable, missing and truncated counts. Qwen self-annotation sensitivity excludes Qwen122 source judge.
